crossRefs.note: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
and the lamp stands with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;
He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

people.name: Most_Holy_Place
people.line: The innermost room of the tabernacle and temple

translations.web: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.
translations.bsb: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.
translations.kjv: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
translations.asv: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Jehovah unto its place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.
